candidates.text: The split function must not apply calculate_sm_nft_bonus even when the lock is marked as an SM-NFT.
evidence_ids: Remove the calculate_sm_nft_bonus logic from the split function, even if the lock is marked as an SM-NFT. Users already receive the SM-NFT bonus at the time of lock creation, and reapplying the bonus during a split introduces a critical vulnerability. Allowing the bonus to be added again during each split enables attackers to exploit the system by repeatedly splitting and merging locks to farm unearned bonus tokens.

candidates.text: The SM-NFT bonus must be granted only once, at the time of lock creation, and must not be reapplied during a split.
